newsitem.title: FRANCE: SocGen warns anew on Cr Lyonnais aid - interview.
newsitem.headline: SocGen warns anew on Cr Lyonnais aid - interview.

text.p: Societe Generale chairman Marc Vienot said in a newspaper interview to appear on Thursday that he would not hesitate to enter the fray once again over government aid to state bank Credit Lyonnais.

"I do not know the new one (state aid plan)," he was quoted as saying in an interview in Les Echos newspaper. "But if looks like what is being suggested in the press, you can bank on my contributing to the debate.

"It would be stunning if our fellow-bank kept its profitable assets to compete with us and made the taxpayer foot the bill for the sell-off of its unprofitable assets, and all this amid a remarkable lack of transparency," he said.
